name: com.mjgame.nmd.nkl.20.monetization
description:
Ads (AppLovin MAX), IAP (Unity IAP v5), Firebase Analytics/RemoteConfig, Adjust/AppsFlyer revenue tracking va In-App Review cho game mobile Unity.

Can import rieng: AppLovin MAX SDK, Firebase (Analytics, RemoteConfig, Crashlytics). Tuy chon: Adjust (USE_ADJUST), AppsFlyer (USE_APPSFLYER), Google Play In-App Review. Bat IAP bang define USE_IAP.

Game tu luu DataMonetization trong DataSave va gan DataMonetization.Current (xem Samples).

samples.description: DataSave mau luu DataMonetization va MonetizationBridge noi Ads/IAP voi UI cua game.
